row.team_price_text: Growth: starts at $0 (first 1M monthly events free, then usage-based)
row.evidence: Mixpanel's SSO docs say users on a Growth plan or above can enable SSO, but only accounts with an Enterprise plan have access to SCIM at the moment; the Okta setup guide also requires an active Enterprise plan subscription.
row.notes: Event-volume pricing, unlimited seats, so per-user fields stay null. Conflict: the pricing page's combined row 'SAML-based SSO & SCIM provisioning' is marked Available on Growth (read from page markup), while the SSO docs, the Okta guide and the Entra and JumpCloud pages all say SCIM needs Enterprise. Status kept gated per the docs (behaviour page) at medium confidence; flag for review. Change from June: SAML SSO is now on Growth (June said SSO and SCIM were Enterprise-only). June's '$0.28/1K events' is now shown only in page markup ('$.00028 per event after'), and June's '~$25K+/yr' Enterprise figure has no first-party source, so it is dropped. Google Workspace is SSO only (JIT, no auto-provisioning). Mixpanel warns that JumpCloud SCIM has hard-deleted users unexpectedly. No documented org-member REST API beyond SCIM.

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: Starts at $0 (first 1M events free, up to 20M)
plans.notes: Pricing page markup marks 'SAML-based SSO & SCIM provisioning' Available on Growth; docs say SCIM is Enterprise-only (see conflicts). Slider offers yearly and monthly billing.

auth.token_source: Organization Settings > Access Security > SCIM (shown once; regenerating revokes the old token)

deprovision.notes: Okta guide: deactivates the user, or deletes the account if specified. Seats are unlimited on all plans.

group: displayName (must match the Mixpanel Team name)
attributes.notes: Docs name only First Name, Last Name and Email as supported profile attributes; SCIM attribute paths are not documented.

roles.how: Per-user Organization Role and project access cannot be set from the IdP; groups map to Mixpanel Teams, whose role and project access are set inside Mixpanel. Provisioned users join as Organization Member.

limitations.text: SCIM affects only users whose email domain is a verified claimed domain; provisioning fails otherwise.
Org role and project access cannot be provisioned from the IdP.
Mixpanel warns JumpCloud SCIM has hard-deleted users unexpectedly.
No auto-provisioning with Google Workspace (JIT only).
Mixpanel implements a SCIM spec subset.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log on all plans (90-day retention on Free/Growth, 2 years on Enterprise); the docs mention an audit log API but no endpoint reference was found.

user_api.notes: The API reference index lists data, query, GDPR and Service Accounts APIs but no organization member/user management endpoints; members are invited in the UI.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push/Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not loaded; facts from Mixpanel's docs.
